control_flow: Inside followLine: if the line tracker reads below 30 %, curve left; else if it reads above 70 %, curve right; else drive forward at 20 %.

likely_intent.description: Follow the black line through its curves to the green goal at its end, staying on the line.

decision_points.condition: first: the line tracker's brightness is below 30 % (black); second: it is above 70 % (bright)

branches.outcome: the reading is below 30 % (black): it curves left
the reading is above 70 % (bright band or peach floor): it curves right
the reading is between 30 and 70 %: it drives straight

equivalence_classes: beside the line on the bright floor
input_dimensions.dimension: where the robot starts relative to the line

scenarios.coded_response: It curves left while the reading is below 30 %, right while it is above 70 %, and drives straight in between.
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot starts on the black line, facing along it, with the line running ahead through its curves.
scenarios.trigger: The line tracker sees black, then the bright band, again and again as the line bends.
scenarios.title: Follows the line through its curves to the goal
assumptions: The green goal is an area at the end of the line; the robot cannot sense it, it only follows the line there.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It follows the line through its curves to the green goal at the line's end, without leaving it.
